articles.title: Bitcoin stuck under $74,000 as CoreWeave earnings revive AI outlook, Anthropic said to raise IPO valuation
articles.snippet: CoreWeave’s revenue surge lifted AI infrastructure stocks and Nasdaq futures, while bitcoin was little changed over 24 hours.

articles.title: US data center restrictions could give Bitcoin miners an edge in AI, though challenges remain
articles.snippet: As US voters push back against new data centers, Bitcoin miners already expanding into AI could benefit from their existing facilities.

articles.title: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts
articles.snippet: Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline.

articles.title: FSB urgest Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules
articles.snippet: The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators.

articles.title: Barclays boosts BlackRock Bitcoin ETF stake 48% as banks expand holdings
articles.snippet: Barclays reported a $187 million stake as of Sept. 30, while Citigroup disclosed a new $119 million position in Fidelity’s Bitcoin ETF.
